cookie.domainSemantics: Host-only; deploy the Worker on the final API custom domain before issuing production sessions.
cookie.productionNameNote: Better Auth may add the __Secure- prefix when secure cookies are enabled. Clients must use Set-Cookie/getCookie rather than hard-code a cookie name.

web.cors: Exact configured origins only; wildcard origins are forbidden.
web.csrf: Better Auth origin and Fetch Metadata checks remain enabled for every mutation.
web.storage: No session material in localStorage or JavaScript-readable cookies.

mobile.request: Read authClient.getCookie(), set the Cookie header only for the exact API origin, and use credentials: omit.
mobile.retry: One session-refresh retry is allowed; then clear secure auth state and require sign-in.
mobile.logout: Call the server sign-out endpoint before clearing SecureStore and cached session state.

session.suspension: Every protected request re-checks accounts.is_suspended. Suspension revokes all sessions immediately.
session.renewal: Every canonical and protected API response forwards Better Auth renewal Set-Cookie headers.
session.clearing: Expired, invalid, logged-out, and suspended sessions return an expired canonical session cookie.
session.access: Cloudflare Access is not a consumer authentication mechanism.
session.bearerTokens: Not part of the v1 consumer contract.
session.clientIp: Only Cloudflare's single-value CF-Connecting-IP is trusted; forwarded IP headers are ignored.
session.legacyPassword: Unsupported legacy hashes return the same generic invalid-credential response and require the reset/account-claim flow.

requirements: Explicit production runtime and data-cutover attestation
Verified Cloudflare Email Sending domain and approved sender attestation
HTTPS API, web, and passkey origins with matching RP ID
Independent 32-byte-minimum Better Auth and media signing secrets
productionReadiness.emailRetry: Queue payloads contain only an opaque retry UUID; email addresses and verification/reset tokens are never queued or logged.
